thesis: The podcast explores the future of energy, arguing that new technology creates demand which exposes a lack of supply, prompting the construction of new supply that drives prosperity and economic growth. It specifically focuses on how energy storage and non-wires alternatives can lower the cost of moving electrons to address aging infrastructure and support the AI revolution.
